messages:
Sam: Quick thread 1: Prospect (HelixCare) wants a 2-week POC: Azure AD SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning + RBAC with nested groups. Also pushed a security questionnaire asking about CMK and 12-month audit logs. Need answers + rough Hosted vs Dedicated pricing by Thurs.
Aisha: I'll own the SAML checklist. Need IdP metadata XML, desired ACS URL, whether they want SP-initiated, IdP-initiated, and any group attribute names (memberOf/groups). Also ask if they sign/encrypt assertions.
Diego: SCIM questions: push vs pull? We support full list + incremental via lastModified filter. Groups can be pushed; we flatten nested groups unless they set parentGroup in the payload. SCIM accepts externalId on groups/users which we use for tenant mapping. Sample group snippet: {"displayName":"eng","externalId":"tenant-helix","members":[{"value":"u-123"}]}
Sam: Security items: logs 12mo and CMK. Hosted default logs 90d; Dedicated/Private can extend to 12mo for extra. CMK is available for Dedicated/Private via KMS integration.
SecurityBot: Links: SOC2 & ISO27001 docs available on request. DPA: https://redwood.example/legal/dpa. CMK guide: https://redwood.example/ops/kms.
Aisha: Pricing back-of-envelope: POC (hosted, low usage) ~$4k/mo; Dedicated starter (2 reserved GPUs) ~$19k/mo baseline; Production-medium (4 reserved + HA) ~$40k+/mo. Embeddings heavy -> add consumption. Need tokens/month / embeddings/hour to refine.
Diego: Action items: Aisha -> send SAML checklist + sample SP metadata to Helix (ETA: tomorrow). Diego -> SCIM/RBAC mapping doc + sample PATCH (ETA: EOD). Sam -> draft Hosted vs Dedicated delta pricing table and questionnaire answers (ETA: Thu).
Sam: I'll schedule a 30m working session with their infra lead. Requesting IdP metadata, SCIM base URL + token, sample group payload, and expected token/embedding volumes before call.
Aisha: Once metadata arrives we can validate SAML and flag blockers.
Diego: Also ask if they require SLO/IdP-initiated SAML; SLO adds setup time.
Sam: Great, keep updates here. :thumbsup:
